messages:
srinivas: anyone seeing a sudden eviction spike in ap-southeast1? our tiny-gang jobs are getting Preempted en masse :rotating_light:
maya: yep noticed it ~10m ago, a lot of warmpool nodes flapping NotReady
ops-bot: alert: route-flap detected between ap-southeast1 and onprem-bgp-1 (peer down). Affected nodes: gpu-node-apse1-[14..27]
liam: can you paste a quick kubectl snapshot? wondering if it's kubelet or network TTL
maya: here are the pod failures i pulled:```
$ kubectl get pods -n ml-workloads -o wide | grep -E "Preempted|CrashLoopBackOff"
model-train-7   0/1   Evicted   0   10m   gpu-node-apse1-19
rampup-3       0/1   Evicted   0   9m    gpu-node-apse1-21
embedder-2     0/1   CrashLoopBackOff  3  8m    gpu-node-apse1-23
```
jen: infra team — did the network team change any BGP timers or provisioning this morning?
srinivas: @jen not that i'm aware of, but infra-bot shows a config push to onprem-bgp-1 at 06:42 UTC
infra-bot: config-push: onprem-bgp-1 by netops@redwood (change-id: cfg-2026-03-12-422). Modified hold-time from 90 -> 30s.
liam: ah that would do it. shorter hold-time => faster flap detection => nodes pulled from routing table quicker, kubelet sees delta and marks NotReady
tim: immediate mitigation: can we relax scheduler eviction thresholds or temporarily increase warmpool headroom to avoid preempts? both are quick config toggles
maya: i'm +1 to headroom bump. cost tradeoff though — we're on a tight monthly GPU commit for Dedicated. extra warm nodes will hit cost buckets :money_with_wings:
srinivas: suggest short window: bump warmpool min from 3 -> 8 in ap-southeast1 for next 30m, then monitor eviction rate. if stable, gradually lower. also open a quick canary reschedule to eu-west1 for high-priority pods
jen: netops is rolling back to previous hold-time now and will monitor BGP session for 15m. i'll put a note in the change and ping if anything else shows.
ops-bot: action created: NET-4321 investigate BGP hold-time rollback (assigned to netops).
liam: i pushed a temporary scheduler override:"warmpool-min: 8" to ap-southeast1 (ephemeral). watch metrics: pods_preempted, pod_restart_rate
maya: metrics are showing preempted rate dropping already, good sign :thumbsup:
jen: FYI cost impact — projected delta for next 24h with warmpool bump: ~+$12k (est). doing 30m -> negligible, but just flagging for finance heads
srinivas: noted. when netops confirms BGP stable for 15m, i'll revert warmpool-min back to 3 and run a controlled drain test on the affected nodes to repro and collect kernel logs
tim: for postmortem: capture node-level conntrack drops, kubelet event timestamps, and any az-level egress metrics. i can help wire up the eval dashboard
maya: quick note — several jobs lost progress; recommend doing a light checkpoint restore for long-running model-train jobs once nodes are stable
liam: rolling recap: cause = aggressive BGP hold-time change -> route flap -> nodes marked NotReady -> scheduler evictions; mitigation = netops rollback + ephemeral warmpool bump; next = collect logs + revert override after 15m stable
jen: i'll close NET-4321 after 2 green checks from netops and post in #incidents
srinivas: thanks all. ping if anything flares back up.
